Message:
drm/radeon: fix S/R on VM systems (cayman/TN/SI)

We weren't properly tearing down the VM sub-alloctor
on suspend leading to bogus VM PTs on resume.

Fixes:
https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=60439
